narrative.details:
adventurer, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Eleanor Shackleton near Brill.
narrative.offerRewardText: I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
